title: Journey
description: One reconstructed field trip of Bela Bartok, derived from dated song records by geo/derive-journeys.mjs as specified in docs/JOURNEY-SPEC.md. journeys.json is { _meta, journeys: Journey[] } with journeys sorted by id. Nothing here is asserted beyond what the record dates and places support; every inferred value carries a confidence.

id.description: J-YYYY-MM-nn: year and month of the first stop, nn = 01-based sequence within that month. Fuzzy trips with no known month use MM = 00.

kind.description: route = every record has a full date, stops are ordered in time and drawn as a polyline. cluster = only year or year+month known; stops are unordered and drawn as a cluster hull, no polyline.

collector.description: Collector name as printed on the records (normalised, e.g. 'Bartok Bela').

dateStart.description: ISO date, month or year of the first record.

dateEnd.description: ISO date, month or year of the last record.

dateConfidence.description: Finest date precision shared by all records in the trip.

days.description: Inclusive length in days for route trips; null for clusters.

confidence.description: 'assumed' means the configured default (Budapest, Bartok's home base) was used; the UI labels it as such.

seq.description: 1-based order along the route; for clusters the order is alphabetical by village and carries no temporal meaning.

placeId.description: location.placeId of the records, when resolved.

arrival.description: Earliest record date at this stop (ISO date, month or year).

departure.description: Latest record date at this stop.

kmFromPrevious.description: Great-circle distance from the previous stop (or from the departure point for seq 1); null for clusters or when coordinates are missing.

locationConfidence.description: unresolved stops have no coordinates and are listed but not drawn.

distanceKm.description: Sum of kmFromPrevious over resolved stops (departure -> first stop -> ... -> last stop); the return leg is not included. null for clusters.

villages.description: Distinct resolved villages (stops with a placeId or village name).

countiesHistorical.description: Distinct historical counties as printed, sorted.

performers.description: Distinct performer names (null names not counted).

songIds.description: All record ids in the trip, sorted.

gapDays.description: Configured maximum gap between consecutive dated records within one trip (default 10).

jumpKm.description: Configured maximum distance between stops on consecutive days before a split (default 250).

splitReasons.description: Why this trip starts where it does: 'start' for the first trip, 'gap' for a > gapDays gap, 'jump' for a > jumpKm move on consecutive days, 'precision' when the date precision changed, 'year' for a new year in fuzzy trips.
